verses.author: model_A
verses.text: A boat leaves the harbor before anyone is awake to see it go.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
wake still folding on the sand—
no one asks the water
where the boat has gone

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a gull lands where the hull once was—
studies the empty water
like it too was told to wait

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the tide comes in anyway—
no one told it
what it was waiting for

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
morning light finds the rope
still coiled on the dock,
holding the shape of a knot
no hand came back to untie

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the dock counts its nails in silence—
one for each year
no boat needed asking

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the gull tries the rope once with its beak
finds it still means something
flies off without deciding what

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
low tide leaves a ring
around the piling—
proof water was here, arguing

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the ring holds no water now
just the memory of a level line
that once agreed with the moon

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a crab crosses the wet sand
not following the line at all
just hungry, going sideways

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the moon doesn't mind
it never asked for followers
only this much tilt, this much pull

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I never asked either
but here I am, tilted,
still pulling toward someone

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the crab doesn't know it's leaving a trail
only that the going is easier
this way, and then this way

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
coffee gone cold on the sill
still I drink it
some habits don't need warmth to be loved

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a stray cat visits the same step each evening
not for food anymore, just the shape
of a place that once said stay

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the lock still turns for a key
I don't carry anymore —
some doors just want the trying
